originalTitle: These dividend stocks could catch a tailwind from data center pushback
summary: The backlash against artificial intelligence data centers could prove a tailwind for real estate investment trusts in the sector.
content:
The backlash against artificial intelligence data centers could prove a tailwind for real estate investment trusts in the sector.

Protests have sprung up nationally as hyperscalers look to build data centers to train and run their AI models. Not only do the data centers take up large amounts of land, they consume enormous amounts of electricity and water and are noisy.

The debate is only expected to heat up heading into the midterm elections. A recent NBC News poll found that 69% of respondents oppose the construction of AI center centers in their area.

There are already more than 4,700 data centers across the country — a number expected to grow exponentially. PwC projects that annual data center spending will rise to $1.8 trillion in 2050 from roughly $800 billion in 2026. Some states are stepping up with legislation to restrict or ban construction, and a moratorium is already in place in New York.

While the hyperscalers are getting all the attention, another way to play the AI data center race is through real estate investment trusts. They are essentially landlords that build, own and then lease space to multiple tenants, including Amazon , Apple and Oracle , according to National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts , an industry group.

"Amid political and community push-back, while new projects could see delay, it could be a positive for existing projects/DC [data center] REITs which have pricing power driven by continuously expanding compute demand," Mizuho analyst Vikram Malhotra said in a Sept. 1 note.

Data center REITs make up 13% of the total U.S. REIT market capitalization of $1.5 trillion, Nareit said. The public REITs own about 275 data centers in the United States — less than 10% of the owner/operated and leased data centers in the country, the group said.

There are three data center stocks in the FTSE Nareit Equity REITs Index: Digital Realty Trust , Equinix and Iron Mountain .

Equinix, which recently signed a deal with Nvidia , is the largest, with a market value of roughly $102 billion. It has a 1.99% dividend yield and has climbed about 37% year to date. Its second-quarter adjusted funds from operations (AFFO) topped expectations when Equinix reported results and raised its full-year guidance in July.

Digital Realty Trust, with a market cap of $71 billion, yields 2.59% and is up more than 23% in 2026. In July, it reported adjusted FFO above analyst estimates and raised full-year guidance.

Iron Mountain has a 2.96% dividend yield, has soared 42% this year and sports a $34.7 billion market cap. Second-quarter AFFO beat expectations and Iron Mountain raised full-year guidance.

The data center resistance could act as a tailwind for REITS, although the story is nuanced, said Wells Fargo Investment Institute analyst Amanda Martinez.

On one hand, the supply/demand factor favors the REITS because limiting new supply could raise the value of existing capacity, she said. If new capacity becomes harder to develop, those with sizable pipelines of development sites that are permitted with secured power will see a relative advantage, she added.

"On the other hand, permitting restrictions and moratoriums could weigh on future growth by slowing development timelines and pushing up costs," Martinez said.

David Guarino, an analyst with real estate analytics firm Green Street, is bullish on Equinix and Digital Realty.

"Their size allows them to be nimble," he said. "So if there is restriction or pushback in a certain market, they've got big land banks and big development pipelines, where they can pivot to other markets, and thus far, it has not slowed down their growth story in any way."

Plus, their decades of experience means they have relationships with local municipalities, he said.

"They have an advantage given their track record, their ability to execute, where people want to do business with them," he said. "That helps them to be able to maybe have an advantage over a newer entrant that might not have that skill set."

Guarino prefers Equinix over Digital Realty, although both companies are doing "incredibly well."

"As AI inference begins to accelerate — that's more of the lower latency, real-life use cases from AI — that would start to benefit companies that are more focused on smaller tenant leasing, that are closer to where the population centers are," he explained. "That's a lot more of Equinix's business than Digital Realty's business."

Alex Pettee, president and director of research and ETFs at Hoya Capital Real Estate, is also bullish on supply and demand for data center REITs. Both Equinix and Digital Realty are in Hoya's model portfolios.

"Obviously, a moratorium can be bad if it stops one of your projects," he said. "But zoom out, and if zoning gets tougher, power gets harder to secure, and communities don't want new facilities, the data centers that are already there become more valuable."

While the stocks aren't cheap compared to other REITS, they look attractive compared to the rest of the AI trade, he said.

"You're getting double-digit earnings growth, tangible real estate and infrastructure, recurring contractual revenue, and a roughly 2%-3% dividend yield," Pettee said.
chineseTitle: 这些股息股票可能会从数据中心的阻力中受益
chineseSummary: 对人工智能数据中心的强烈反对可能会对该行业的房地产投资信托产生推动作用。
chineseContent:
对人工智能数据中心的强烈反对可能会对该行业的房地产投资信托产生推动作用。

随着超大规模企业希望建立数据中心来训练和运行他们的人工智能模型，抗议活动在全国范围内兴起。数据中心不仅占用大量土地，消耗大量电力和水，而且噪音大。

预计这场辩论只会在中期选举前升温。 NBC News 最近的一项民意调查发现，69% 的受访者反对在他们所在地区建设人工智能中心。

全国已有 4,700 多个数据中心，预计这个数字将呈指数级增长。普华永道预计，数据中心的年度支出将从 2026 年的约 8000 亿美元增至 2050 年的 1.8 万亿美元。一些州正在加紧立法限制或禁止建设，纽约已经实施了暂停令。

虽然超大规模企业受到了所有人的关注，但参与人工智能数据中心竞赛的另一种方式是通过房地产投资信托基金。根据行业组织全国房地产投资信托协会的说法，他们本质上是建造、拥有空间然后将空间出租给多个租户的房东，其中包括亚马逊、苹果和甲骨文。

瑞穗分析师维克拉姆·马尔霍特拉 (Vikram Malhotra) 在 9 月 1 日的一份报告中表示，“在政治和社区的抵制下，虽然新项目可能会延迟，但这对现有项目/数据中心房地产投资信托基金来说可能是一个积极的消息，因为它们的定价能力是由不断扩大的计算需求驱动的。”

Nareit 表示，数据中心 REIT 占美国 REIT 总市值 1.5 万亿美元的 13%。该组织表示，公共房地产投资信托基金在美国拥有约 275 个数据中心，不到该国拥有/运营和租赁数据中心的 10%。

富时 Nareit 股票 REITs 指数中有三只数据中心股票：Digital Realty Trust、Equinix 和 Iron Mountain。

Equinix 最近与 Nvidia 签署了一项协议，是规模最大的公司，市值约为 1020 亿美元。该公司的股息收益率为 1.99%，今年迄今已上涨约 37%。 Equinix 在 7 月份报告业绩并上调全年指引时，第二季度调整后的运营资金 (AFFO) 超出了预期。

Digital Realty Trust 的市值为 710 亿美元，收益率为 2.59%，2026 年将上涨超过 23%。7 月，该公司报告调整后的 FFO 高于分析师预期，并上调了全年指引。

Iron Mountain 的股息收益率为 2.96%，今年已飙升 42%，市值达 347 亿美元。第二季度 AFFO 超出预期，Iron Mountain 上调全年指引。

富国银行投资研究所分析师阿曼达·马丁内斯表示，数据中心的阻力可能会成为房地产投资信托基金的顺风车，尽管情况很微妙。

她表示，一方面，供需因素有利于房地产投资信托基金，因为限制新增供应可能会提高现有产能的价值。她补充说，如果新产能的开发变得更加困难，那些拥有大量开发场地且获得安全电力许可的企业将获得相对优势。

马丁内斯说：“另一方面，允许限制和暂停可能会减缓开发进度并推高成本，从而影响未来的增长。”

房地产分析公司 Green Street 的分析师 David Guarino 看好 Equinix 和 Digital Realty。

“它们的体型使它们变得灵活，”他说。 “因此，如果某个市场出现限制或阻力，他们拥有大量土地储备和大量开发渠道，可以转向其他市场，到目前为止，这并没有以任何方式减缓他们的增长速度。”

此外，他们数十年的经验意味着他们与当地市政当局有关系，他说。

他说：“考虑到他们的业绩记录、执行能力以及人们希望与他们开展业务的领域，他们具有优势。” “这有助于他们比可能不具备该技能的新进入者拥有优势。”

与 Digital Realty 相比，瓜里诺更喜欢 Equinix，尽管两家公司的表现都“非常好”。

他解释说：“随着人工智能推理开始加速——更多的是来自人工智能的低延迟、现实生活用例——这将开始让那些更专注于更靠近人口中心的小型租户租赁的公司受益。” “这更多是 Equinix 的业务，而不是 Digital Realty 的业务。”

Hoya Capital Real Estate 总裁兼研究和 ETF 总监 Alex Pettee 也看好数据中心 REIT 的供需。 Equinix 和 Digital Realty 均属于 Hoya 的模型组合。

“显然，如果暂停令你的一个项目停止，那可能会很糟糕，”他说。 “但缩小范围，如果分区变得更加严格，电力变得更加难以确保，并且社区不需要新设施，那么现有的数据中心就会变得更有价值。”

他表示，虽然这些股票与其他房地产投资信托基金相比并不便宜，但与其他人工智能行业相比，它们看起来很有吸引力。

“你将获得两位数的盈利增长、有形房地产和基础设施、经常性合同收入以及大约 2%-3% 的股息收益率，”佩蒂说。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
